name: Goblin Warhorn Captain
displayText: Goblin Tokens you create during your turn have Rush until the end of that turn.

notes: Rush is handed out as part of the Token arriving, so a Token created during your Main Phase can attack the same turn.
A Token is only ever put onto the battlefield by being created, so every Goblin Token that arrives on your turn is one you created.
Tokens created on somebody else's turn get nothing, and Rush lasts only until the end of the turn it was granted on.
This Captain has to already be on the battlefield: its own arrival cannot rewrite itself, and Tokens created before it landed keep whatever they arrived with.
